text:
tomas.reid: Rahul asked for a concise reproducible export that covers RBAC change, KMS rotation (multi-cloud), and vuln->incident chain. He needs exact CLI/UI steps, artifact S3/GCS paths, checksum+signature steps, and SOC2/ISO control mapping.

anya_liu: I'll handle RBAC. Short steps (AWS + GKE + Azure AD examples):
- terraform plan JSON: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform show -json tfplan > /tmp/tfplan.json
- CloudTrail slice (AWS): aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/cloudtrail/Redwood" --filter-pattern "AttachRolePolicy|PutRolePolicy" --start-time 1705000000000 --end-time 1705000360000 > /tmp/iam_events.json
- GCP audit logs: gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName:('SetIamPolicy' OR 'roles')" --start-time=2024-12-10T00:00:00Z --end-time=2024-12-10T01:00:00Z --format=json > /tmp/gcp_iam.json
- Azure AD changes: az ad user get-member-groups --id <id> or export via Azure Portal activity logs.
- k8s bindings: kubectl get rolebinding,clusterrolebinding -o yaml --all-namespaces > /tmp/rolebindings.yaml
Upload layout: s3://audit-exports/rbac/{ticket}/{ts}/tfplan.json, iam_events.json, gcp_iam.json, rolebindings.yaml, approvals.pdf, manifest.txt, manifest.txt.asc
Maps: SOC2 CC6.1, ISO A.9.2.3.

mike_s: I'll take KMS rotation (showing cross-cloud):
- AWS KMS: aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/prod-cmk > /tmp/key_meta.json ; aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/prod-cmk --policy-name default > /tmp/key_policy.json ; aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/aws/cloudtrail/Redwood" --filter-pattern "RotateKey|CreateGrant" --start-time 1705000000000 --end-time 1705000360000 > /tmp/kms_events_aws.json
- GCP KMS: gcloud kms keys describe prod-key --location=global --keyring=prod-ring --format=json > /tmp/gcp_key.json ; gcloud logging read "resource.type=\"kms_key\" AND protoPayload.methodName:('cryptoKeyVersions')" --format=json > /tmp/kms_events_gcp.json
- Azure Key Vault: az keyvault key show --vault-name prod-vault --name prodKey > /tmp/az_key.json ; export activity logs similarly.
Upload path: s3://audit-exports/kms/{provider}/{key_alias}/{ts}/key_meta.json, key_policy.json, kms_events_*.json, manifest.txt, manifest.txt.asc. Include CMK used to encrypt the bundle and policy snapshot.
Maps: SOC2 CC6.2, ISO A.10.1.

auditor_rahul: For incidents, I need ticket -> PR -> build hash -> deploy trace -> alerts -> redacted chat. Also need proof who uploaded and GPG verification steps.

anya_liu: Incident minimal commands: curl -u $JIRA_TOKEN "https://redwood.atlassian.net/rest/api/3/issue/$TICKET" > /tmp/ticket.json ; sha256sum build/artifact.tar.gz > /tmp/artifact.sha256 ; curl -s "https://deploy.api/trace/$DEPLOY_ID" > /tmp/deploy_trace.json ; curl -g "https://prometheus/api/v1/query_range?query=ALERTS&start=1705000000&end=1705000360" > /tmp/alerts.json ; /compliance/export_slack --channel incident-bridge --start 1705000000 --end 1705000360 > /tmp/slack_raw.txt ; python3 /tools/redact_slack.py /tmp/slack_raw.txt /tmp/slack_redacted.txt
Upload: s3://audit-exports/incidents/{ticket}/{ts}/ticket.json, artifact.sha256, deploy_trace.json, alerts.json, slack_redacted.txt, manifest.txt, manifest.txt.asc
Maps: SOC2 CC7.1, ISO A.16.1.3.

mike_s: Checksum+sign steps (required for all bundles): sha256sum /tmp/* > /tmp/manifest.txt ; gpg --local-user <uploader@redwood> --armor --detach-sign /tmp/manifest.txt ; aws s3 cp --metadata uploader=<user>,job_id=<ci_job> /tmp/* s3://... ; when finalizing: apply S3 Object Lock (GOVERNANCE) and set retention and archive to Glacier Deep for 7 years.

compliance-bot: Created task AUD-2026-799 and scheduled verification 2026-04-15T13:00Z.

auditor_rahul: Good. Please attach one RBAC sample (AWS+GKE) and one KMS cross-cloud sample to AUD-2026-799 with exact S3/GCS keys and the manifest.asc so I can run sha256sum and gpg --verify.

anya_liu: Will prepare samples and a short README with verification commands. Tomas & Mike will push before EOD.

tomas.reid: Thanks all — ping auditor when uploads complete.
